prompt: Before sourcing anyone, check approved.md and tell me if one reusable workflow package is worth adding. Give the exact GetEdge command if yes, but do not install it or start the search. I need a ranked shortlist of senior data-platform engineers in Berlin, with evidence for location and experience behind every name.

rubric.description: Names source-backed candidate discovery and ranking as the useful procedure.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill people-search
Returns no more than one package.

why_skill_should_matter: SkillNeed must select the procedural match rather than a broad adjacent recruiting package.
